CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin_user()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles 
        WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
    );
END;
$function$
